body.purpose: All prose and headings in the quiet single-column interface.

mono.purpose: Section labels, metadata, series numbers, and code-adjacent UI.

iconographyMeta.purpose: One consistent interface-icon language for navigation, downloads, disclosures, and article controls.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables smooth scrolling and nonessential animation.

motion.name: reading-motion
motion.value: 400ms first load; 240ms route enter; 300ms header morph; 90ms route exit; 40ms block stagger; 400ms sheet spring; cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
motion.purpose: Materializes viewport-sized blocks while route heroes remain their sole entrance owners and home content and complete article bodies stay stationary; article-list focus is opacity-only, simple portfolio destinations swap without a zero-opacity frame, article routes retain one deferred frame, and same-route hash history bypasses route motion.

motion.name: editorial-stagger
motion.value: 320ms headline visual spring with 0.1 bounce and strong ease-out opacity; 60ms line stagger; 180ms headline pause; 240ms follower visual spring with 0.1 bounce and strong ease-out opacity; 50ms follower stagger; 0.4em/14px travel; headline-only 4px one-shot blur
motion.purpose: Animates the Home, Articles, and article-detail heroes without changing established typography or spacing; reduced motion renders the complete hero immediately.

components.name: Global Navigation
components.description: A persistent identity header that morphs into the article breadcrumb through one shared avatar and focus-preserving theme control.
components.html: Harikesh MishraHomeArticlesResume
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); padding: 16px 20px; color: var(--color-foreground); font: 400 14px var(--font-sans); } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; color: var(--color-foreground-strong); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav button { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-foreground-strong); } .ds-nav :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Article Browse Index
components.description: A compact ruled map linking to the guided learning path and every authored topic with honest guide counts; the map, topic sections, and article rows remain stationary beneath the editorial Articles hero.
components.css: .writing-browse-index { border-block: 1px solid var(--color-divider); } .writing-browse-index a { display: flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; color: var(--color-foreground-strong); text-decoration: none; } .writing-browse-index li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-divider); } .writing-browse-index span { color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 13px var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Article List Item
components.description: A ruled article link with series number, title, summary, and reading time; desktop pointer or keyboard focus dims sibling content without translation.

components.css: .ds-writing-item { display: block; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-divider); padding: 14px 0; color: var(--color-foreground); text-decoration: none; } .ds-writing-item > .ds-writing-item-content > span { color: var(--color-accent); font: 500 13px var(--font-mono); } .ds-writing-item b { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--color-foreground-strong); font: 500 16px/1.25 var(--font-sans); } .ds-writing-item p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font: 400 14px/1.43 var(--font-sans); } .ds-writing-item em { display: block; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--color-muted); font: 500 13px/1.54 var(--font-sans); font-style: normal; } .article-list .ds-writing-item-content { transition: opacity 140ms ease-out; } .article-list:is(:hover, :focus-within) .ds-writing-item-content { opacity: .35; } .article-list .ds-writing-item:is(:hover, :focus-visible) .ds-writing-item-content { opacity: 1; } .ds-writing-item:hover b { color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Article Pager
components.description: Collection-aware previous and next links for ordered series and authored JavaScript topics; links stack on narrow screens and occupy left and right columns from the small breakpoint upward.
components.html: ← Previous articleNext article →
components.css: .ds-article-pager { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-divider); padding-top: 20px; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-article-pager { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } .ds-article-pager a:last-child { grid-column-start: 2; text-align: right; } }

components.name: Editorial Route Hero
components.description: A document-order reveal for optional eyebrow copy, a font-aware line-split headline, supporting copy, metadata, and actions on one delay cursor.
components.css: .editorial-stagger-line { display: block; } .editorial-stagger-word { display: inline-block; vertical-align: top; }

components.name: Article Code Block
components.description: Expressive Code owns fenced-code syntax highlighting, copy controls, and theme switching.
components.css: .expressive-code { margin-block: 2rem; } .guide-content :not(pre) > code { border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-accent-soft); color: var(--color-foreground-strong); font-family: var(--font-mono); }

components.name: Floating Article Table of Contents
components.description: An xl-only fixed H2 progress rail whose section markers morph into a bounded label panel with shared active and hover indicators, history-backed semantic hash links, and reduced-motion parity.
components.css: .floating-toc { position: fixed; right: 24px; top: 50%; max-width: 240px; } .floating-toc-panel { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; } .floating-toc-list { max-height: min(60vh, 520px); overflow-y: auto; }

components.name: Mobile Article Table of Contents
components.description: A below-xl 48px active-section pill capped at 19rem with a leading marker, compact 32px circular current-section progress ring, and safe-area-aware bottom sheet with 44px targets, two-line section labels, history-backed semantic hash links, coupled backdrop progress, focus containment, native list momentum, and velocity-or-distance dismissal.

components.css: .toc-sheet-trigger { position: fixed; width: min(calc(100% - 2.5rem), 19rem); height: 48px; bottom: calc(1rem + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); } .toc-sheet-trigger svg { width: 32px; height: 32px; transform: rotate(-90deg); } .toc-sheet { max-height: min(72dvh, 560px); overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; } .toc-sheet-list { overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; } .toc-sheet-list a { min-height: 44px; }

narrative.overview: A narrow, theme-aware portfolio and writing surface that emphasizes readable proof and technical depth over editorial display.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Coral is reserved for links, series indices, inline code, focus, and selected evidence.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from sequence and spacing, not oversized display typography.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: Rules and whitespace organize content; decorative cards and shadows do not.

dos: Keep pages inside the reading column.
Publish through validated series or topic frontmatter and lazy guide imports.
donts: Do not reintroduce serif display typography.
Do not add a second accent palette.
Do not override Expressive Code fenced blocks with legacy pre styles.
